recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-18319 unless a future publisher change reintroduces duplicate resource-page section numbering.
issue_request: FHIR-18319 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core Patient correction asking that the Resource Patient - Operations page not reuse section 8.1.1, because Patient content already used 8.1.1 for Scope and Usage.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied by commit bb2576b70f74ad6cea8a454b1cb4c7969bdc6a10 on 2018-12-10, titled 'GF#18319 - fix section numbering problem'. That commit changed the old publisher resource-page generation order and changed the JSON schema template heading from h1 to h2, which addressed the generated section-numbering collision.
additional_context: Patient remains active in the current build configuration, and source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml defines the current Patient operations list. The old Java Publisher file touched by the historical commit is no longer present in this checkout, but the current templates retain h2 headings for operations and JSON schema pages. Current CI output renders Scope and Usage as 8.1.1 and Resource Patient - Operations as 8.1.19. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision for this numbering-only correction.
reconciliation: No source files were changed; the current source/build state already reflects the requested correction and the visible current specification no longer has the duplicate Patient operations 8.1.1 section number.
